name: GitHub user search

measures.definition: GitHub accounts whose profile location names the city, per 1,000 residents (city population from GeoNames); only the total count of the search is read.

licence: No data licence: only total counts of profiles are stored (GitHub Acceptable Use Policies, section 7)

rights.edition: GitHub REST API, search users (total_count only), read 2026-11-05
rights.attribution: Counts of GitHub profiles by stated location, from GitHub's public user search (counts only, no profile data)

fetch.rateLimit: 10 searches a minute without a token

vetted.notes: Only a count is kept, no account. The Acceptable Use Policies allow public, non-personal information to be used for research published openly; a total count of profiles is that kind of information. Owner to confirm this reading of the terms.

caveats: Counts follow what people type: many leave the location empty, some name a nearby big city, and a name shared by two places mixes them (such places get no figure).
Populations are GeoNames figures, the city proper for most places but the metropolitan area for a few (Sydney, Melbourne), which lowers their rate.
Searches only the place's names held here (Brussels, not Bruxelles or Brussel, unless listed as aliases).
